tests.name: PPV_AT_OBSERVED_PREVALENCE
tests.requirement: Projected PPV at exact original prevalence reproduces frozen precision.

tests.name: PPV_MONOTONICITY
tests.requirement: For fixed TPR>0 and FPR>0, PPV increases with prevalence.

tests.name: FP_INVARIANCE
tests.requirement: FP=FPR*1,000,000 is invariant across prevalence for a fixed operating point.

tests.name: COST_BREAK_EVEN_SIGN_REVERSAL
tests.requirement: Model-vs-ignore inequality reverses immediately around analytic pi_star_cost.

tests.name: CONFUSION_IDENTITIES
tests.requirement: TP+FN equals attack volume and FP+TN equals 1,000,000.
